Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: exact small pixel terrain corner material donors, transparent sprite sheet.
Reference image is the approved native 32px terrain materials. Match the SAME fine pixel clusters, low saturation, dark quiet center and fine edge highlights; this sheet adds missing CONCAVE inner corners for that terrain.
Layout: 4 ROWS by 4 COLUMNS, square 1536x1536 transparent canvas. No grid lines, no text, no labels. Leave generous fully transparent gutters between every square. Each cell is one flat FRONT-facing square piece of solid material, almost square with just a SMALL irregular concave notch bitten out of ONE corner. It is not an isometric cube, NOT a ring, not a hole floating in the middle.
Columns EXACTLY:
1 northwest/top-left notch; 2 northeast/top-right notch; 3 southeast/bottom-right notch; 4 southwest/bottom-left notch.
The notch touches BOTH outside edges at that corner. Other outer edges of the material piece are straight/full, no detached decorative objects. Small missing notch only 15–25% of cell width; the narrow natural bevel is confined to about 40% of cell width near that corner, remainder quiet flat matching shadow material. Preserve natural broken pixel alpha at the missing corner. No cast shadows outside the square. Real RGBA transparency for background and notches, NOT painted checkerboard.
Rows TOP TO BOTTOM:
1. Thorn Forest: quiet dark brown root-soil #302c28 with small worn ochre bark rim, moss olive only on upward-facing ledges
2. Mushroom Caverns: quiet slate-purple #302c40 stone, subtle layered mauve rim, thin mycelium not many cyan mushrooms
3. Firefly Marsh: dark damp peat #362e34, brown root threads, wet olive moss on upward surfaces
4. Windswept Canyon: quiet burgundy sandstone #493843, thin warm sandy worn ledge
Light comes from upper left for ALL cells. Do not rotate the same artwork: gravity-sensitive moss and ice hang correctly across all four notches. These will be baked into 16x16 native terrain quadrants. Keep topology legible, very small controlled texture, no high-frequency noise or black void center, no thick cartoon outline. Match the reference material brightness, not bright new textures.
